name: ZhuZhou QianJin Pharmaceutical Co.,Ltd
summary: ZhuZhou QianJin Pharmaceutical Co.,Ltd engages in the production and sales of Chinese and Western medicines in China. The company offers traditional chinese medicine that cover areas, such as pelvic inflammatory disease, menstrual disorders, cervicitis, dysfunctional uterine bleeding, breast hyperplasia, postpartum blood and qi deficiency, and menopausal syndrome; chemical products that covers areas, including gynecology, cardiovascular system, endocrine system, liver and kidney diseases, oncology and immune system, antiviral, psychotropic, and tonic products; API; TCM derivatives; and hygienic products, such as gynaecological and baby nursing, and maternity pad/ maternity package.
